en.t: If the corridor makes any noise, it is so embarrassing!

units.source_text: 就是悄悄走，人家也会晓得的呀。

en.t: Even if I walk quietly, people will still know.

units.source_text: 我打厨房经过，人家就取笑我说：‘阿驹，又到山茶厅去啦？’

en.t: When I pass by the kitchen, they tease me and say, 'Koma, off to the Camellia Room again?'

units.source_text: 真想不到我还在这种事情上顾忌人家多心啊。”

en.t: I never imagined I would become so worried about people getting ideas over something like this.
